## Description

Please include a summary of the change, relevant motivation, and context. Link any related issues using `Fixes #` or `Resolves #`.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style / Refactor (formatting, renaming, no logical code change)
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (adding missing tests or optimizing existing test suite)
- [ ] 🚀 Performance improvement

## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests that you ran to verify your changes. Include instructions so maintainers can reproduce.

- [ ] Automated tests via `pytest -v`
- [ ] Interactive manual GUI test on Linux desktop (Ubuntu / GNOME / Wayland / X11)
- [ ] Desktop integration check (`install-desktop.sh`)

**Test Environment Details:**

## Checklist
